root_cause.text: The `eth_get_drvinfo()` function in `drivers/usb/gadget/function/u_ether.c` unconditionally dereferences `dev->gadget`, which can become NULL during the unbind window when a prior commit (`ec35c1969650`) reparents the gadget device and clears the pointer, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when userspace queries ethtool.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Commit ec35c1969650 ... reparents the gadget device to /sys/devices/virtual during unbind, clearing the gadget pointer. If the userspace tool queries on the surviving interface during this detached window, this leads to a NULL pointer dereference." The patch adds a NULL check (`if (dev->gadget)`) before accessing `dev->gadget->name` and `dev->gadget->dev`.
